ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

channels.name: RF Carrier (13.56 MHz)
channels.direction: PCD → field; PICC receives via inductive coupling
channels.purpose: Continuous unmodulated 13.56 MHz carrier that powers the PICC and serves as the synchronous clock reference for both PCD and PICC framing.
channels.active_levels: Field strength 1.5..7.5 A/m at operating volume; envelope 100% (Type A pause) or ≈ 90% (Type B 10% ASK) when modulated

channels.name: PCD→PICC modulation
channels.purpose: Carries 7-bit short frames (REQA/WUPA), standard frames (SELECT, RATS, T=CL blocks), and anti-collision bit-frames as ASK envelope changes on the 13.56 MHz carrier.
channels.active_levels: 100% ASK Modified Miller (Type A) or 10% ASK NRZ-L (Type B)

channels.name: PICC→PCD load modulation
channels.purpose: Carries ATQA, UID-CLn[]+BCC, SAK, ATS, and T=CL reply blocks as load-resistor switching that produces a 847.5 kHz subcarrier sideband on the PCD-side antenna voltage.
channels.active_levels: Subcarrier amplitude ≥ 22 / sqrt(H_field_strength) mV at PCD reference antenna
channels.idle_level: No subcarrier (PICC load resistor not switching)

channels.name: PCD Host Bus (SPI/I2C/UART)
channels.purpose: Application-side path between host MCU and the PCD reader IC. SPI is most common; CLRC663 / PN5180 / MFRC522 typically expose 4-8 MHz SPI clock.
channels.active_levels: Per host-bus convention (3.3 V CMOS or 1.8 V LVCMOS)

channels.name: PCD IRQ
channels.purpose: Asynchronous interrupt indicating frame received / TX complete / error / collision.
channels.active_levels: Active LOW (typ) or HIGH per chip

power_pins.name: PCD AVDD
power_pins.purpose: Analog supply for PCD oscillator / modulator / RX path (typ 3.3 V).

power_pins.name: PCD DVDD
power_pins.purpose: Digital supply for PCD logic (typ 3.3 V or 1.8 V).

power_pins.name: PCD PVDD
power_pins.purpose: Pad / antenna driver supply (typ 3.3 V or 5 V depending on antenna power requirement).

power_pins.name: PICC LA / LB
power_pins.purpose: PICC antenna coil terminals. The PICC has no external VCC pin — VCC is rectified from the LA/LB inductively-coupled field.

global_signals.name: 13.56 MHz RF carrier
global_signals.purpose: Shared synchronous time base for the entire PCD-PICC system. Subcarrier and ETU are both fc-divided.

ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_wire_type_a: Bytes in protocol order; bits LSB-first within each byte; one odd-parity bit follows each byte.
ordering_rules.byte_ordering_on_wire_type_b: Bytes in protocol order; bits LSB-first within each byte; one start bit + 8 data + 1 stop bit + 2-ETU EGT per character.
ordering_rules.uid_byte_order: UID-CL1[0] first (== Cascade Tag 0x88 if not final CL); CL2 and CL3 chained.

dependency_graph.common_rule: PCD transmits the carrier continuously; PICC powers itself from the carrier and replies only within fdt_listen of a recognised PCD command. There is no PICC-initiated traffic — the PCD is the sole initiator.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: PCD command framing depends on the current PICC state (POWER_OFF / IDLE / READY / ACTIVE / HALT / T_CL_ACTIVE). Anti-collision depends on the bitwise replies of the PICCs in field. Layer 4 traffic depends on a successful RATS/ATS handshake.

handshake_pairs.name: REQA_ATQA
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD REQA (7-bit) → PICC ATQA (16-bit) within fdt_listen.

handshake_pairs.name: AC_SELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD SEL+NVB → PICC UID-CLn[]+BCC. Full SELECT (NVB=0x70) → PICC SAK + CRC_A.

handshake_pairs.name: RATS_ATS
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD RATS (0xE0 + PARAM) → PICC ATS (TL + T0 + ... + CRC_A) within FWT.

handshake_pairs.name: T_CL_I_BLOCK
handshake_pairs.rule: Alternating-block-number I-Block round-trips carrying APDU; flow controlled by FWT + WTX.

handshake_pairs.name: HLTA
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD HLTA → PICC silent ACK → HALT.

handshake_pairs.name: S_DESELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: PCD S(DESELECT) → PICC S(DESELECT) ACK → HALT.
